purpose: One-time Agent Form semantic quality pilot using a verified source-capture checkpoint.
endpoint_policy: http://127.0.0.1:11434 only; loopback-only; no cloud inference
acceptance_gates: restore checkpoint and verify all pinned source evidence
validate Agent Form mission payload and task DAG
complete two candidate purpose analyses and six specialist roles per candidate
run independent reviewer on both candidates
record structured-output validity, accepted/rejected evidence, task failures, reviewer disagreement, model digest and elapsed time
do not scale until pilot quality is manually and programmatically assessed
